title: Instruction Pair (SFT)
description: Single instruction-following training example emitted by Trainforge's synthesize_training stage. One JSONL line per pair. Shapes are intentionally flat so downstream SFT trainers (Alpaca/OpenAI) can remap with a single projection.

prompt.description: The instruction a model must answer. Must not contain a verbatim span of 50+ consecutive characters from the source chunk text.

completion.description: The target completion the model should produce.

chunk_id.description: Source chunk id from imscc_chunks/chunks.jsonl (Phase 7c rename of corpus/chunks.jsonl, e.g. sample_course_chunk_00042).

lo_refs.description: Learning-outcome refs the source chunk maps to. Never empty: chunks without LO refs do not generate pairs.

content_type.description: Content-type label from the source chunk. Free-string (derived from content_type_label or chunk_type when the label is missing).

seed.description: Seed used for deterministic template selection and sampling. Same chunk + same seed -> identical pair.

decision_capture_id.description: event_id from the decision-capture log that records why this pair was synthesized. Resolves against the run's decisions JSONL.

template_id.description: Id of the prompt template used (bloom-level x content-type). Optional but useful for debugging.

provider.description: Which synthesis provider produced the pair.

question_type.$comment: 9-value canonical enum mirrored from schemas/taxonomies/question_type.json#/$defs/QuestionType. Inlined (not $ref'd) until P2.5 migrates this schema to Draft 2020-12; cross-draft $ref resolution is implementation-specific. Drift between this enum and the canonical taxonomy is a documentation bug — see plans/wave-D1-p0-fixes-2026-05-07.md § T1.2.
question_type.description: Canonical question-type discriminator consumed by the W6.B per-question-type summary and W7.A-C per-metric segmentation. Optional so legacy corpora pre-Wave-8 stay schema-valid.

promotion_status.description: GPT Feedback v2 P0c Fix 7a — training-pair promotion ladder. Optional on first land; emitter assigns 'pending' on first emit, then upgrades through candidate / validated / trainable / rejected per the TrainingPairPromotionValidator (Wave 2).

rejection_reason.description: Free-string rejection rationale. Populated only when promotion_status == 'rejected'.

observed_bloom.description: BERT-ensemble classification of the emitted prompt+completion. Null when classifier didn't run.

bloom_alignment.description: True iff observed_bloom == bloom_level. Null when observed_bloom is unset.

answer_support_score.description: Cosine similarity (or per-pair entailment score) between completion and the cited source chunk text. Null when the score wasn't computed.

rationale_richness_score.description: Heuristic semantic-richness score over the rationale string. Null when not computed.

source_chunk_id.description: Stable id of the source chunk this pair was synthesized from. Optional in general; required when promotion_status == 'trainable' (see if/then clause). Closes the source-free-generation hole at the schema layer.

per_claim_support.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.A — per-sentence NLI entailment audit of the completion against the cited chunk text. One entry per sentence the claim-support validator scored. Null when NLI deps are missing (graceful-degrade) or when the validator hasn't run on this pair yet (legacy / pre-Wave-4 corpora). Mirrors the W2.E promotion_status migration shape: optional day-1, may upgrade to required-conditional once the validator has rolled across every active corpus.

sentence.description: The verbatim sentence extracted from the completion that was scored by the NLI classifier.

entailment.description: Post-softmax NLI entailment probability for (premise=chunk_text, hypothesis=sentence). When Wave 5 W5.D per-claim attribution scoping fired (source_chunk_ids non-null), this is the max-over-cited-chunks entailment so a sentence backed by ANY cited chunk is entailed.

contradiction.description: Post-softmax NLI contradiction probability for the same (premise, hypothesis) pair. When Wave 5 W5.D per-claim attribution scoping fired (source_chunk_ids non-null), this is the max-over-cited-chunks contradiction so a sentence contradicted by ANY cited chunk is contradicted.

outcome.description: Bucketed verdict per the W4.A thresholds — entailment_floor (default 0.70) and contradiction_floor (default 0.50). Wave 9 TIGHT adds the ``dart_disagreement`` value: the IMSCC NLI pass scored ``entailed`` but the dual-source DART cross-check (resolved via the cited chunk's ``source.source_references[].sourceId``) re-scored at >= the DART-side contradiction floor (0.50). Audit-only signal — does NOT reject the pair; gate-runner walk surfaces aggregate-rate ``DART_DISAGREEMENT_RATE_HIGH`` warning when the rate exceeds 5%.

source_chunk_ids.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 5 W5.D — per-claim attribution scoping. List of DART/Courseforge chunk-IDs that were used as the NLI premise(s) for this sentence, copied from the matched ``key_claims[].source_chunk_ids[]`` entry on the cited chunk. Null when (a) the cited chunk did not carry the W1.5 / W5.A structured ``key_claims`` shape, (b) the call site did not thread a ``chunk_id_to_text_map`` lookup, or (c) the sentence did not cosine-match (floor 0.50) any structured claim — in any of those arms the validator graceful-degraded to whole-chunk-text NLI scoring for this sentence and no per-claim attribution applies.

entailment.description: Wave 9 TIGHT — max-over-DART-blocks NLI entailment for (premise=union of cited DART block texts, hypothesis=sentence).

contradiction.description: Wave 9 TIGHT — max-over-DART-blocks NLI contradiction for the same (premise, hypothesis) pair.

outcome.description: Wave 9 TIGHT — DART-side bucket. ``dart_disagreement`` fires when contradiction >= 0.50; the per-claim outer ``outcome`` is bumped to the same value to surface in the aggregate-rate warning at the gate-runner walk.

dart_source_check.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 9 TIGHT — dual-source DART cross-check (chunker-drift slice). Stamped only when (a) the IMSCC NLI pass scored this sentence as ``entailed``, (b) the call site threaded ``dart_block_text_map`` + ``dual_source_severity != 'off'`` into ``PairClaimSupportValidator.validate_pair``, and (c) at least one of the cited chunk's ``source.source_references[].sourceId`` resolved against the staged DART HTML map. Absent when any of those conditions is false (back-compat day-1 — the field is optional, legacy corpora pass schema validation unchanged). Closes the chunker-drift slice (Finding 5) — W2.F fires before IMSCC chunking, so it can't see ``merge_small_sections`` / sentence-split sub-chunking drift.

claim_support_rate.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.A — fraction of scored sentences whose outcome was 'entailed'. Null when NLI deps are missing or the validator hasn't run on this pair.

claim_contradicted_rate.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.A — fraction of scored sentences whose outcome was 'contradicted'. Null when NLI deps are missing or the validator hasn't run on this pair.

phantom_los.description: LO refs declared by the pair that the cited chunk does NOT carry (case-insensitive set difference). Empty on pass; non-empty triggers W4.B 'phantom_pair_lo_refs' rejection.

pair_lo_resolution.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.B — audit-trail surface for the per-pair LO-resolution check. Null when the validator hasn't run on this pair (legacy / pre-Wave-4 corpora).

pair_objective_alignment.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.C — per-(pair, objective_id) delivery-alignment audit emitted by PairObjectiveDeliveryValidator. One entry per learning-outcome ref the pair claims to teach / assess. Mirrors the W1.7.C Block.objectiveAlignment surface but at pair scope (NLI entailment of the objective statement against prompt+completion + Bloom-level gap + action-verb presence). Null when the validator hasn't run on this pair (legacy / pre-Wave-4 corpora) or NLI deps are missing (graceful-degrade). Mirrors the W4.A / W4.B day-1 contract: optional now, may upgrade to required-conditional once the validator has rolled across every active corpus.

objective_id.description: Canonical learning-outcome id (TO-NN / CO-NN) the pair claims to teach / assess. Preserves emit case.

status.description: Tri-axis verdict per the W4.C contract: 'delivered' (NLI-entailed AND Bloom-met AND verb present), 'underdelivered' (NLI-unsupported OR Bloom-undermet), 'verb_only' (action-verb hit but NLI-unsupported), 'unverifiable' (NLI deps missing or LO statement absent — graceful-degrade).

statement_entailment_score.description: Post-softmax NLI entailment probability for (premise=prompt+completion, hypothesis=objective_statement). Null when NLI deps are missing or the LO statement couldn't be resolved.

contradiction_score.description: Post-softmax NLI contradiction probability for the same (premise, hypothesis) pair. Null when NLI deps are missing.

bloom_gap.description: Difference declared_bloom_index - observed_bloom_index over the canonical 6-value Bloom enum (remember=0 .. create=5). Positive = pair operates BELOW the declared Bloom level (under-delivery); zero = aligned; negative = above. Null when observed_bloom couldn't be classified.

verb_match_count.description: Number of declared-LO action-verb tokens (from the LO statement's leading verb phrase, normalised) found in the pair's prompt+completion. Null when the LO statement couldn't be resolved.

declared_bloom.description: Declared Bloom level of the cited learning objective (canonical 6-value enum). Null when the LO statement couldn't be resolved.

observed_bloom.description: BERT-ensemble classification of the pair's prompt+completion (canonical 6-value enum). Null when the classifier didn't run.

entailment_threshold.description: NLI entailment floor used to decide the 'delivered' vs 'underdelivered' axis on this call. Captures the per-call threshold so audit replay is deterministic across threshold-recalibration waves.

pair_objective_alignment_pass_rate.description: GPT Feedback v2 Wave 4 W4.C — fraction of pair_objective_alignment[] entries whose status == 'delivered'. Null when pair_objective_alignment is null or empty.
